objects.name: Analytic 1759
objects.description: For iOS, detect Exploitation for Privilege Escalation by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Host Status via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; Network Traffic Flow via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: Unified Log entry at level=fault in subsystem com.apple.kernel or com.apple.sandbox within $KernelFaultWindow$ of integrity_check failure — kernel-level fault coincident with integrity failure is the exploit-execution signal; requires super]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
